title: Visit Chargeback Rate for Long-Tenure Comfort Club Members
content:
When a Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements agreement is cancelled, visits completed in the term are charged back at their retail value multiplied by a visit chargeback rate. Long-tenure agreements with a record of kept visits are charged back at a reduced rate.

## Visit chargeback rule
- **Long-standing:** an agreement first enrolled at least **120 months** before the date of handling whose completed tune-up and whole-home visits on record number at least **8** is charged back at the long-standing visit rate of **0.6**.
- **Established:** an agreement first enrolled at least **60 months** before with at least **4** completed visits on record, that does not meet both long-standing conditions, is charged back at the established visit rate of **0.8**.
- **Any other agreement:** this rule gives no reduced rate.

Months enrolled are whole calendar months from the agreement's enrolled date to the date of handling. Visits on record are all completed tune-up and whole-home visits on the agreement, in any term.

## Combinations

| Months since first enrolled | Completed visits on record | Visit chargeback rate |
|---|---|---|
| 120 or more | 8 or more | 0.6 |
| 120 or more | 4 to 7 | 0.8 |
| 60 to 119 | 4 or more | 0.8 |
| 120 or more | 3 or fewer | no reduced rate |
| 60 to 119 | 3 or fewer | no reduced rate |
| fewer than 60 | any | no reduced rate |

## Example (hypothetical, two tune-ups completed in the term at 109.00 each, 218.00 at retail)
- 130 months, 9 visits on record: 218.00 multiplied by 0.6 gives 130.80.
- 130 months, 6 visits on record: 218.00 multiplied by 0.8 gives 174.40.
- 70 months, 3 visits on record: no reduced rate under this rule.
